## English

- Restores the Remote settings card border and rounded corners in Harness 0.1.6.
- Adds inner spacing and limits the card width to keep the settings layout compact.

## 中文

- 恢复 Harness 0.1.6 远程设置卡片的边框与圆角。
- 增加内边距并限制卡片宽度，改善设置页布局。
